items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: I met Milt at Michael’s Pub in New York, I think it was that time when Scott was playing with them. It was one of his first gigs in New York and I came by and sat in and everything.

ctx.x: I met Milt at Michael’s Pub in New York, I think it was that time when Scott was playing with them. It was one of his first gigs in New York and I came by and sat in and everything. I think that was the first time I met Milt. It just feels like I’ve known him forever at this point. That would have to be it, I’m sure that was it.
